name: so101_cube_to_bin_mujoco_v0
description: MuJoCo Menagerie RobotStudio SO-101 cube-in-bin benchmark with fixed object and bin eval cases.
notes: Requires MuJoCo Menagerie robotstudio_so101/so101.xml from AUTORESEARCH_SO101_MJCF, MUJOCO_MENAGERIE_PATH, or .external/mujoco_menagerie and fails closed if the real RobotStudio/Menagerie model is missing.
The achieved goal is the cube center; success means the cube center is inside the bin tolerance.
